verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's structure and reading order intact (badge, logo, headline, three cans with their names, CTA, footer), but it is just a wider copy: the cans and the 'Bright & zesty' taglines stay tiny, there is a lot of dead space between the columns and at the bottom, and the cans' label text can't be read. B is broken: two of the three cans shrink to thumbnails stuck in the bottom-left corner, and the flavour names, taglines and delivery line are jammed into one centred stack in the wrong order, cut off from the cans they describe (so 'Bright & zesty' no longer sits with Blood Orange). The CTA is pushed into the top corner and crowds the badge, and the oversized headline nearly touches both edges.
